newsitem.title: USA: Medical Resources buys imaging chain.
newsitem.headline: Medical Resources buys imaging chain.

text.p: Medical Resources Inc said Tuesday it has completed the acquisition of Advanced Diagnostic Imaging Inc for $10.6 million in cash.
ADI's annual net revenues are about $15.5 million.

Medical Resources specializes in the operation and acquisition of diagnostic imaging centers. The company operates 51 imaging centers and provides network management services to managed care organizations. The company also provides temporary healthcare staffing to acute and sub-acute care facilities nationwide.
